title: The Elves and the Shoemaker
description: A kind shoemaker receives mysterious help at night, then finds a way to thank the tiny visitors who changed his fortunes.
catalogueBlurb: A grateful shoemaker discovers who has been helping him each night.

cover.alt: Historic illustration of the elves helping the shoemaker.

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on the Brothers Grimm public-domain tale
text.notes: The underlying Grimm tale is public domain; this wording is an original Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.notes: Both selected source files are marked public domain on Wikimedia Commons.

text.source: Lucy Crane's 1886 English translation of Household Stories, transcribed in Project Gutenberg eBook #19068
text.notes: Uses Part I of 'The Elves', the shoemaker story only. The complete Lucy Crane wording is retained without abridgement or modernisation; Project Gutenberg front matter, the unrelated Parts II and III, and licence boilerplate are excluded.
